name: maccabi-online-skills
description: Unofficial skills for Maccabi Online, the Maccabi Healthcare Services (Israel) member portal: doctor messages, appointments, medications and purchase history, test results, visit summaries, vaccinations, commitments (hitchaivut), refunds, cardless visits and a family-member switcher. Drives the user's own signed-in Chrome. Writes are gated behind explicit confirmation. Includes an admin skill that re-maps the portal when its UI changes.
